findings.title: Job is left to another controller, which has not run it
findings.cause: Job train has spec.managedBy batch.example.com/scheduler, so Kubernetes' Job controller leaves it alone and creates no pods; in 12m0s that controller has not started it either (the Job has no status), so it is not running here or does not take this Job

evidence.what: Job train has spec.managedBy batch.example.com/scheduler and no status after 12m0s
evidence.command: kubectl get job train -n kd-job-managed-by-missing-controller -o jsonpath='{.spec.managedBy}{" "}{.status}'

findings.fix: Run the controller that batch.example.com/scheduler names, or create the Job without spec.managedBy so Kubernetes' Job controller runs it (the field cannot be changed on an existing Job: delete and recreate it).
